findings.issue: הַפָּסַח is a definite common noun, not a proper name; «Pésaj» leaves the lemma untranslated and capitalizes it as a title.
בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ is an open common noun (appointed time, place, or meeting); «cita» narrows it to an appointment.

notes: Y, harán (qal imperfect 3mp), hijos de Israel, the object marker, and the 3ms suffix match the tokens.
